prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Korean woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep burgundy-black shadow smudged heavily beneath both eyes, sharp black liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a glossy near-black wine lip, sharply contoured cheekbones, a cold, poised expression, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a copper hammer head, an iron barrel-shaped weight, a gold square-sided cowbell, a bronze small flared temple bell, an iron cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal bracelet.
